s11-introduction-to-priority-queues-usin.trick: A binary heap keeps its maximum (or minimum) at the root. Priority queues support constant-time top and logarithmic push/pop.
s11-introduction-to-priority-queues-usin.time: O(n log n) to remove all n values

s11-min-heap-and-max-heap-implementation.trick: Store the complete binary tree in an array. Sift a new value upward on push; after removing the root, sift the replacement downward.

s11-check-if-an-array-represents-a-min-h.trick: A min-heap requires every parent to be no greater than its children. Check each non-root node against its parent.

s11-convert-min-heap-to-max-heap.trick: Bottom-up heapify: sift down every internal node, starting from the last parent. This builds a max-heap in linear time.

s11-kth-largest-element-in-an-array-use-.trick: Keep the k largest values in a min-heap. Its root is the kth largest after all elements are processed.

s11-kth-smallest-element-in-an-array-use.trick: Keep the k smallest values in a max-heap. Its root is the kth smallest.

s11-sort-k-sorted-array.trick: In a k-sorted array, the next smallest element must be among the next k+1 input positions. Keep those candidates in a min-heap.

s11-merge-m-sorted-lists.trick: Put each nonempty list's head in a min-heap. Repeatedly append the smallest node and insert its successor.
s11-merge-m-sorted-lists.time: O(N log m), N total nodes and m lists

s11-replace-each-array-element-by-its-co.trick: Sort and deduplicate a copy. An element's rank is its lower-bound position in that sorted list plus one.

s11-task-scheduler.trick: The most frequent task creates maxFrequency−1 gaps of length cooldown+1. Tasks tied for maximum frequency occupy the final slots.

s11-hands-of-straights.trick: Always start with the smallest remaining card. Remove one copy of each of the next groupSize consecutive values; any missing value makes grouping impossible.

s11-design-twitter.trick: Store each user's tweets in time order. To build a feed, heap-merge the latest tweet from the user and every followee, taking only ten posts.
s11-design-twitter.time: O(1) average post/follow/unfollow; O(f + 10 log(f+1)) feed
s11-design-twitter.space: O(T + F), tweets T and follows F; O(f) feed heap

s11-connect-n-ropes-with-minimal-cost.trick: Always join the two shortest ropes first. Their combined length is paid now and can be reused in later joins.

s11-kth-largest-element-in-a-stream-of-r.trick: Maintain a min-heap of the k largest values seen so far. After each insertion, its root is the kth largest.

s11-maximum-sum-combination.trick: Sort both arrays descending and start at pair (0,0). Pop the largest sum, then try its right and down neighbors once each.
s11-maximum-sum-combination.time: O(n log n + C log C) for C answers

s11-find-median-from-data-stream.trick: Keep the lower half in a max-heap and upper half in a min-heap. Rebalance so the lower heap has either equal size or one extra.

s11-k-most-frequent-elements.trick: Count frequencies, then keep only the k most frequent distinct values in a min-heap. Remove the smallest frequency when the heap grows.
s11-k-most-frequent-elements.time: O(n + u log k) expected, u distinct values
